model_evaluation: WED DEV only; LOCKED and ArUco inputs not opened
reason: Measured component baselines do not constitute a complete five-stage freeze; depth/geometry and end-to-end remain gated.

classification.limitation: Uses isolated ground-truth food crops and a clean TRAIN-only gallery; this is a component baseline, not end-to-end classification.

depth_geometry.limitation: The required synthetic metric-depth baseline and real marker/scale diagnostics have not been frozen together.

end_to_end.limitation: No real DEV full-meal critical-failure baseline is recorded for this feature.

segmentation.limitation: Uses deployed multi-item masks; label identity is not inferred by SAM2, so item coverage is the fraction of GT dish regions matched at IoU >= 0.5.

weight.limitation: Existing DEV reference is available; verify hashes/configuration and freeze it before candidate tuning.
